families.description: Crossed a gate and never adopted the next gate as its target.
Passed the gate plane outside the gate: a DNF, not a slow lap.
Hit something after having crossed at least one gate.
Died on a tightly spaced leg with little room to settle after the crossing.
Switched target but never aligned on it or never closed range.
Died on a long leg where small heading error integrates into large lateral error.
Crossed, but far enough off centre that the next transition started compromised.
Died where yaw and depth had to change together; neither axis alone was extreme.
Died on a leg demanding a large descent.
Died on a leg demanding a large heading change to port.
Died on a leg demanding a large climb toward the surface.
Died on a leg demanding a large heading change to starboard.
Failed deep in a sequence with no discrete event, after absorbing a large total depth change: vertical drift.
Failed deep in a sequence with no discrete event, after absorbing a large total heading change: lateral drift, not a single bad corner.
Never reached the first gate: acquisition or approach, not chaining.
Died inside alternating left/right transitions (an S), where each correction must be unwound immediately.
Died inside a sustained same-direction turn sequence (a spiral).
